explanatory_strength.rationale: Company-level capital-cycle story is specific (Taiwan build-out, equity-funded capacity, CATV +179% alongside datacenter mix shift to 54% of Q1 2026 revenue), but the industry supply-response alternative is not quantified enough to separate peak from normalized incremental returns.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: Filings anchor FY2025 revenue, capex, customer concentration, and normalized owner cash, yet required industry capacity additions, utilization, maintenance-versus-growth capex benchmarks, and peer supply lead times are absent; the customer_capex_reserve proof is a judgment reserve, not a capacity equation.

downside_control.rationale: A negative cycle reserve (-$12/sh base) and bear scenario exist, but hyperscaler concentration (82% top two), ongoing dilution (60M to 76M shares), and $179M capex exceeding OCF leave tail loss paths only loosely bounded.

return_vs_alternatives.rationale: At $99.77 the base Lawrence IRR is -13.4% per year and the contract mid-cycle sum is ~$16/sh versus ~$100 price; normalized economics do not clear a portfolio hurdle even before industry oversupply.

claims.claim: FY2025 capital spending was $179.1M versus operating cash flow $174.4M; diluted shares rose from ~60M to ~76M after equity offerings funding Taiwan datacenter capacity.
Digicomm and Microsoft together were ~82% of FY2025 revenue (top five customers 95%), while CATV revenue jumped 179% YoY in the same upcycle year datacenter mix reached 54% of Q1 2026 revenue.

Normalized owner cash is $0.74 per share after assuming $130M capex ($49M above mid-cycle maintenance); the hyperscaler_share_runway component adds $8/sh base via a single judgment row with no reinvestment DCF despite overlap with datacenter growth in the core engine.

strongest_counter_explanation: Scarcity in 800G datacenter optics and vertical laser integration may sustain above-normal returns even as AAOI adds Taiwan capacity, because hyperscaler socket wins and MSO Quantum Bandwidth upgrades extend the upcycle longer than historical CATV volatility implies.
most_important_missing_fact: Industry-wide 800G optical transceiver capacity additions, utilization rates, and supply lead times for peer module vendors (not just AAOI's Taiwan build) needed to test whether current margins invite a credible supply response.
falsifiers: Reported capex falls toward maintenance with gross margin holding near 30% for two consecutive years
Top-two customer concentration falls below 70% of revenue without margin collapse
Peer or industry data show 800G utilization staying above 85% with limited new module capacity announcements
specialist_findings: The packet correctly flags an upcycle and normalizes company capex, but it capitalizes peak revenue mix (CATV +179%, FY2025 +83%) while the midcycle_capacity_value reserve is judgment-only and industry supply discipline is unmeasured. At today's price the market appears to price bull-cycle share gains, not normalized incremental returns on reinvested capacity.
